Description: Uncovered a JSON Web Token, which may lead to unauthorized access to web applications and sensitive user data.
Author: Billy
Message:
Issue 6: Carry one request id through every log line, redact in the logging layer and check Redis in readiness.

The request context gains site_id and actor_id (bound late by get_current_user and the HTML shell
onto one mutable per-request object) and the middleware, now plain ASGI and outermost, returns
X-Request-ID on every response, including CSRF refusals and 500s. A RedactionFilter on the console
and S3 handlers masks phone numbers, OTPs and tokens in messages, extra fields and tracebacks from
any module. The console writes NDJSON by default (LOG_FORMAT=text keeps the old line), LOG_LEVEL is
an enum, and /health/ready pings REDIS_URL (skipped when unset, 503 when unreachable) while
liveness stays dependency-free.
